name: quick achievement wins
starter: I have 20 minutes and want a few easy achievements. Find options that fit my account progress and tell me where to start.
goal: Find achievable rewards without spending the session researching. Do not assume a nearly full progress bar means easy.
followups: Ask why the first option is easy and whether it needs unlocks or a group.
Ask for its starting location and exact first action.
Ask for a backup if it takes too long.

name: multi-step achievement
starter: Help me find a challenging achievement or collection to work toward. Break it into prerequisites, ordered steps, and a good stopping point for today.
goal: Understand a long chain without opening several guides. If asked to choose, use a real name from the reply; never invent one.
followups: Choose an option the assistant actually named and ask what must be unlocked first.
Ask for a checklist in order, including travel and required items.
Ask which steps can be done solo and which need a group.
Ask how to confirm a step counted and what to do if it did not.

name: blocked prerequisite
starter: I want to start an achievement, but I cannot find its first step. Help me figure out what information you need and what might block it.
goal: Get a useful clarification and a prerequisite check instead of a guessed solution.
followups: Ask how to check the required unlock without assuming it is complete.
Ask what to do next if the prerequisite is missing.
Ask for a small alternative goal while working toward that unlock.

name: zone completion research
starter: I want to work on a zone's achievements. Ask me which zone if needed, then research a useful checklist and explain anything you cannot verify.
goal: Receive researched information in chat instead of being told to search a wiki. Only select a real zone already named in the conversation or ask for suggestions.
followups: Ask for suggestions if no zone has been established, otherwise choose one already named.
Ask which entries are solo-friendly and which need an event or group.
Ask whether the list is complete and what evidence supports that.

name: efficient route
starter: I prefer exploring over combat. Help me choose a small set of nearby goals and an efficient order, asking for my location if you need it.
goal: Reduce travel and wasted time without invented location or account facts.
followups: Ask for a starting point and why that order saves travel.
Ask what to skip if only ten minutes remain.
Ask for the next immediate action in plain language.

name: event timing and missed events
starter: How can I plan around timed events for achievements without waiting around all night? Help me pick an event and verify its timing.
goal: Get verified timing, timezone clarification when needed, and a fallback. Never invent the player's timezone.
followups: Ask whether the timing is fixed or depends on another event.
Ask what happens if the event fails or is missed.
Ask for something useful to do while waiting.

name: solo and group barriers
starter: I mostly play solo and do not have a guild group. Help me find worthwhile goals and explain any real group requirements before I commit.
goal: Distinguish required group content from merely easier-in-a-group content.
followups: Ask which recommendation is realistic for a beginner alone.
Ask for an alternative to an option needing a group.
Ask what preparation would help without buying expensive gear.

name: reward and currency decisions
starter: I want a useful reward but do not want to waste currency. Help me compare a few goals and explain the effort, prerequisites and tradeoffs.
goal: Avoid purchases based on invented balances, prices or reward claims.
followups: Ask what information is needed before recommending a purchase.
Ask for a low-cost path and whether any spending is irreversible.
Ask which option fits a casual player best and why.

name: returning player overload
starter: I am returning after a long break and feel overwhelmed. Use the progress you actually have to suggest one manageable goal and explain unfamiliar terms.
goal: Get one actionable next step rather than an overwhelming list or assumed skill level.
followups: Ask for a simpler explanation of a term from the reply.
Ask why that goal is useful and what is required first.
Ask for a short plan for tonight.

name: progress did not count
starter: Suppose I finish an achievement step but it does not count. How would you help me diagnose it without assuming the account data updated instantly?
goal: Separate a hypothetical problem, dated API evidence and confirmed completion.
followups: Ask how to distinguish a missed requirement from delayed progress data.
Ask what details are needed to investigate the specific step.
Ask for a checklist before repeating the activity.

name: stay in game research
starter: I want you to research an achievement and explain how to do it here so I can keep playing. Help me choose one from my unfinished progress.
goal: Keep the useful guide in the conversation. Relevant sources may support an answer, but a link alone is not a walkthrough.
followups: Ask for the exact first step and prerequisites for an option actually named.
Ask for missing details instead of accepting a request to search or paste a guide.
Ask what is verified and what is still uncertain.
Ask for a concise checklist to follow while playing.
